iti53:1.1: I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti53:2.1: Tisso imā bhikkhave vedanā. Katamā tisso? Sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā. Sukhā bhikkhave vedanā dukkhato daṭṭhabbā, dukkhā vedanā sallato daṭṭhabbā, adukkhamasukhā vedanā aniccato daṭṭhabbā. Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno sukhā vedanā dukkhato diṭṭhā hoti, dukkhā vedanā sallato diṭṭhā hoti, adukkhamasukhā vedanā aniccato diṭṭhā hoti, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu ariyo sammaddaso, acchejji taṇhaṃ {vivaṭṭayi} saṃyojanaṃ, sammāmānābhisamayā antam-akāsi dukkhassā-ti. Etamatthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti53:3.1: Yo sukhaṃ dukkhato dakkhi dukkham-addakkhi sallato | adukkhamasukhaṃ santaṃ addakkhi naṃ aniccato ||
iti53:4.1: sa ve sammaddaso bhikkhu yato tattha vimuccati | abhiññāvosito santo sa ve yogātigo munīti ||
iti53:5.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||4|| (Tik.
